desc:
IT'S CRUNCH TIME: Hearty garlic blended with rye chips for a satisfyingly crunchy texture

INTENSE TASTE: Seasoned with robust garlic flavor, it's a fan-favorite snack the whole family will enjoy

CRAFTED WITH TRADITION: This crowd-pleasing rye snack is based on a signature Gardetto family recipe

GARDETTO'S SPECIALTY: Crafted with you in mind, featuring a snack of only your favorite crunchy, double roasted garlic rye chips

CONTAINS: Twelve 8 oz snack bags of Gardetto's Special Request Garlic Rye Chips
features:
Features

  1. Roasted rye chips with bold garlic seasoning
  2. Based on Gardetto’s original family recipe
  3. Crunchy and hearty texture
  4. Made with enriched wheat and rye flours
  5. 160 calories per serving (½ cup)
  6. Comes in 8 oz bags (pack of 12)

Benefits

  1. Rich garlic flavor for a bold taste experience
  2. Crunchy texture satisfies snack cravings
  3. Convenient and portable for on-the-go snacking
  4. Trusted brand with long-standing heritage
  5. Ideal for parties, road trips, or quick munching
  6. Great long shelf life
ingredients: Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, riboflavin, thiamin mononitrate, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (high oleic canola, high oleic soybean, high oleic sunflower, palm, fractionated palm, palm olein and/or soybean), Rye Flour, Sugar, Salt. Contains 2% or less of: Yeast, Monosodium Glutamate, Maltodextrin, Dried Worcestershire Sauce (vinegar, molasses, corn syrup, salt, caramel color, garlic powder, sugar, spice, tamarind, natural flavor), Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Fumaric Acid, Spice, Sodium Diacetate, Disodium Inosinate, Disodium Guanylate, Caramel Color. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
